cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Expand Your Jurisdiction
cards.instruction: Use every new problem as a reason to expand what you are entitled to control.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Accounts keeps missing tea because the kitchen's locked. I need control of the keys.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here's a key. But the cleaners keep locking the kettle in their cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then I'll approve their cleaning checklist. The kettle stays out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Their contractor only takes instructions from the building manager.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the building manager's instructions need my approval. Otherwise accounts can't reliably have tea.

mechanism: A imitates a misunderstood control practice, then treats each exposed practical problem as grounds for wider decision rights.
confusable: D48 expands repair scope; D72 expands what A is entitled to control.
comparison: Kitchen keys and contractor chain versus room bookings and road closures.
seedUse: Preserve helpful key/arrival information as the path to wider control, not mere obstruction.
